PreToolUse.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($raw) { $j = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $tool = $j.tool_name; if ($tool -eq 'run_in_terminal') { $cmd = [string]($j.tool_input.command); if ($cmd -match 'npm install') { Write-Output '::BUNDLE-GUARD:: Check bundle budget after installing (npm run build:guard).' } } } } catch {} exit 0"
